verdict_reason: Both prior findings (stale DEBUG log default, disabled-swagger-but-enabled-api-docs) are resolved, but the new springdoc block's comment now contradicts its own code and should be corrected.

todos.issue: The comment above the new springdoc block says '/v3/api-docs stays enabled everywhere', but the code directly below it sets api-docs.enabled: false in the base config (it's now only re-enabled via application-local.yml and application-integration-test.yml overrides) -- the comment now says the opposite of what the code does.
todos.fix: Rewrite the comment to describe the actual behaviour: api-docs and swagger-ui are both disabled by default in application.yml and explicitly re-enabled per-profile in application-local.yml (local dev) and application-integration-test.yml (OperatorComplianceIT).
